input: Plan a weeknight taco bar for the family

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Weeknight Taco Bar for the Family
gold.taskDescription: Organize and execute a fun, easy taco bar dinner on a weeknight for the whole family.

questions.title: Which specific weeknight are you targeting for this?
questions.description: Identify the exact night so timing and prep can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: How many people are you cooking for?
questions.description: Know the headcount to scale ingredients and portions correctly.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions or allergies in the family?
questions.description: Account for vegetarian, gluten-free, or allergy needs when planning the menu.

questions.title: What protein or proteins do you want to offer?
questions.description: Determine whether to serve ground beef, chicken, shrimp, beans, or a mix.

questions.title: Do you want to cook everything from scratch?
questions.description: Clarify how much to rely on store-bought shortcuts like pre-seasoned meat or jarred salsa.

questions.title: What is your rough budget for this meal?
questions.description: Set a spending limit to guide ingredient choices and quantity decisions.

questions.title: How much total time do you have to prep and cook?
questions.description: Understand the available time window on a busy weeknight to keep the plan realistic.
